# Erdos.p94 — Erdős problem 94

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/94
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/94.lean`, theorem `erdos_94.variants.regular_ngon`, AMS 5 52).

Erdős and Fishburn also make the stronger conjecture that $\sum f(u_i)^2$ is maximal for the
regular $n$-gon (for large enough $n$).

## Statement
∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ P : Finset ℝ²,
    P.card = n → ConvexIndep (P : Set ℝ²) →
    ∑ u ∈ distanceSet P, (distanceMultiplicity P u : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ u ∈ distanceSet (regularNGon n), (distanceMultiplicity (regularNGon n) u : ℝ) ^ 2

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
